page.overview:
What is Adventure Phantom Freddy?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Phantom Freddy's appearance is almost identical to his core series counterpart but smaller. Like most of the Phantoms, his eyes are big white dots with single white rings around them. His left ear has been completely removed, replaced by wires. Aside from his missing ear, Phantom Freddy is completely intact.

Phantom Freddy is a great character for giving enemies status effects, as his entire arsenal of attacks is just status effect moves like lowering Attack, Speed, and Defense from enemies, each of them can last around 1 minute when used. However, this makes Phantom Freddy incredibly useless in combat, as none of his attacks deal any damage at all. Because of this, try to use him as a supporting party member while the player should bring other strong party members such as Adventure Withered Bonnie or Adventure Nightmare Freddy. He is also useful for lowering an enemy's attack status effect in Hard Mode.
